ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the horizontal revenue and expenditure balance of a certain river basin, with the unit being 100 million tons. At the bottom of the figure there is “Total water use 177.90”; above it, three sources of water use flow in through connecting lines: on the left is “Reservoir water storage 36.63”, in the middle is “River water diversion 85.84”, and on the right is “Groundwater extraction X”. Then reason: According to the figure, the three items of reservoir water storage, river water diversion, and groundwater extraction together constitute the total water use, so the equation is 36.63 + 85.84 + X = 177.90. Moving terms gives X = 177.90 - 36.63 - 85.84 = 55.43. Therefore, the amount of groundwater extraction is 55.43 100 million tons.

再推理：根据图示，水库蓄水、河流引水、开采地下水三项共同构成总用水量，所以列式为 36.63 + 85.84 + X = 177.90。移项得 X = 177.90 - 36.63 - 85.84 = 55.43。因此，开采地下水量为 55.43 亿吨。
